column1: # changes.tsv - the registry of changes that ship behind a switch, read by core/machines/observers/delivery.sh.
# Columns (tab separated): id, project, commit (a sha, or - to find the trunk commit whose message has the trailer line `Change: <id>`),
# switch (the file in config/ that turns it on, or -), proof (switch, or log:<file under config|data|state>:<regex>, or -), what.
# Every change that ships behind a switch gets a row here in the same commit, with that trailer on the commit, so no report has to guess.
# The state machine slices below are read through the machine view (config/machine-view) or enforced through config/machine-enforce.
